paragraphs: Children in Lambeth's care live with carers approved by the council's own fostering service or by independent agencies, including those listed on this page. Lambeth has said you need to be over 21 and have a spare bedroom, and that you do not have to own your home.

The council sets out a clear route in. After an online or email enquiry it aims to reply within two days, and to arrange a home visit within a week. The assessment that follows includes health and criminal record checks and the Skills to Foster course. Your assessment then goes to a fostering panel whose members include independent people, social work professionals, current foster carers and young people who have grown up in care, and Lambeth's lead officer for children's social care makes the final decision before your induction begins.

Lambeth also recruits emergency foster carers for children who need somewhere safe at short notice, for stays of no more than 14 days. Its 2024 appeal said carers on the emergency rota receive a £100 weekly retainer, plus £200 a week each time a child is placed with them out of office hours, on top of the standard weekly fostering allowance for the child's age. It asks for 28 days' notice to leave the scheme.
If you are thinking about fostering in Lambeth, speak to the council and to two or three of the agencies below, and compare the training, support and pay each offers.
